_note: Only ERROR-level findings individually verified as false-positives or intentional/vestigial are suppressed. Non-blocking warnings/info are NOT baselined. Never bulk-baseline.

suppressions.reason: False positive. roadmap_send_digest is a WP-Cron hook (const CRON_HOOK) scheduled via wp_schedule_event in class-roadmap-pro-digest.php; WP-Cron fires it, not an explicit do_action, so the static audit cannot see the fire site.

Demo import runs through admin_init -> handle_demo_import (form submission) in class-roadmap-demo-import.php, which is the live path. The roadmap-admin.js AJAX call to this action is a legacy no-op; import functions without it.

Reserved Pro extension filter. Free fires roadmap_settings_tabs (Pro adds its tabs via that) but does not yet apply roadmap_settings_fields; the Pro listener is a harmless no-op reserved for injecting fields into Free tabs in a later release.
Reserved Pro extension filter for augmenting changelog shortcode data. Free does not yet apply it; the Pro listener is a harmless no-op with no runtime effect.

Display-rules option read with a safe default (widget shows everywhere) in class-roadmap-pro-feedback-widget.php. No admin UI writes it yet; the read falls back to the default so behaviour is correct. Admin control planned post-1.7.0.

False positive, same shape as roadmap_send_digest above. roadmap_pro_prune_analytics (Roadmap_Pro_Analytics::PRUNE_CRON_HOOK) is a WP-Cron hook scheduled via wp_schedule_event in class-roadmap-pro-analytics.php's constructor; WP-Cron fires it, not an explicit do_action. Confirmed live and scheduled: `wp cron event list` shows it next-runs in ~24h on a daily recurrence. Added 2026-09-28, Bugs 10346173450.

False positive. roadmap_purge_orphan_votes is a single WP-Cron event (product-roadmap.php PURGE_HOOK) armed with wp_schedule_single_event on upgrade and activation and cleared on deactivation; WP-Cron fires it, not an explicit do_action, so the static audit cannot see the fire site. Verified by running the event and seeing the orphans removed.
